title: Episodic store
description:
Create chatbot/memory/episodic.py with an episodic memory store that serializes and persists conversation turns into the VectorStore (via pgvector). Implement save_turn, query_by_session, and query_by_time_range. Use the VectorStore interface from phase c; do not construct SQL directly.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/memory/working_memory.py (from task d.1)
- Any existing VectorStore interface or base models from prior phases (phase c)
- Any existing chatbot/memory/__init__.py

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/memory/episodic.py and chatbot/memory/__init__.py (if exports are needed). Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/memory/episodic.py exists and implements save_turn, query_by_session, query_by_time_range
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: write raw SQL instead of using VectorStore interface
